final.summary: Exhaustive DFS over all feasible job sequences (≤ ~110k prefixes for 8 jobs). Each extension checks deps already in prefix (absent/self deps make a job unselectable; cycles are naturally impossible), computes earliest start = max(release, t + setup[prev_fam][fam]) then pushes forward past overlapping half-open blackouts until no overlap, and enforces completion <= deadline. Every prefix is a candidate; best is chosen by (max value, min completion, lexicographically smallest ID list). Passes all 4 public fixtures. Minor uncertainty: interpretation of unusual inputs (e.g. duplicate IDs) which the spec rules out.
